# Twerge

Twerge is a Go library that optimizes TailwindCSS usage in Go templ applications by intelligently merging Tailwind classes and generating short, unique class names for improved runtime performance.

## What It Does

Twerge performs four key functions:
1. **Intelligent Class Merging**: Resolves conflicts between competing TailwindCSS classes according to Tailwind's precedence rules
2. **Short Class Generation**: Creates optimized class names (e.g., "tw-1", "tw-2") from merged classes  
3. **Static Code Generation**: Generates CSS, Go, and HTML files for production builds
4. **Runtime Performance**: Provides fast lookups using pre-generated static maps

## Core API

### Basic Functions
```go
// Main function - converts TailwindCSS classes to optimized class names
twerge.It("bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600")

// Conditional class application
twerge.If(isActive, "bg-green-500", "bg-gray-500")
```

### Class Merging Examples
```go
// Conflict resolution - later class wins
twerge.It("text-red-500 text-blue-500") // → "text-blue-500"

// Specific overrides general
twerge.It("px-4 pl-2") // → "px-4 pl-2" (both preserved)

// Modifier preservation  
twerge.It("hover:bg-red-500 focus:bg-blue-500") // → both preserved
```

## Usage in Templ Files

```templ
package views

import "github.com/conneroisu/twerge"

templ Button(primary bool) {
    <button class={twerge.It("px-4 py-2 rounded " + twerge.If(primary, "bg-blue-500 text-white", "bg-gray-200 text-gray-800"))}>
        Click me
    </button>
}

templ Layout() {
    <div class={twerge.It("min-h-screen bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 flex flex-col")}>
        <header class={twerge.It("bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md")}>
            <div class={twerge.It("container mx-auto px-4 py-4 flex justify-between items-center")}>
                <!-- header content -->
            </div>
        </header>
        <main class={twerge.It("container mx-auto px-4 py-6 flex-grow")}>
            <!-- main content -->
        </main>
    </div>
}
```

## Code Generation Workflow

### 1. Create Generation Script
```go
//go:build ignore

package main

import "github.com/conneroisu/twerge"

func main() {
    g := twerge.Default()
    err := g.CodeGen(
        g,
        "views/gen_twerge.go",    // Generated Go file
        "views/twerge.css",       // Generated CSS file  
        "views/twerge.html",      // Generated HTML file
        views.Button(true),       // Components to analyze
        views.Layout(),
        // ... other components
    )
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
}
```

### 2. Generated Output

**CSS File** (`views/twerge.css`):
```css
/* twerge:begin */
/* from px-4 py-2 rounded bg-blue-500 text-white */
.tw-1 {
    @apply px-4 py-2 rounded bg-blue-500 text-white;
}
/* from min-h-screen bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 flex flex-col */
.tw-2 {
    @apply min-h-screen bg-gray-50 text-gray-900 flex flex-col;
}
/* twerge:end */
```

**Go File** (`views/gen_twerge.go`):
```go
package views

import "github.com/conneroisu/twerge"

func init() {
    twerge.SetCache(map[string]twerge.CacheValue{
        "px-4 py-2 rounded bg-blue-500 text-white": {
            Generated: "tw-1",
            Merged: "px-4 py-2 rounded bg-blue-500 text-white",
        },
        // ... more mappings
    })
}
```

### 3. Build Process
```bash
# 1. Generate twerge files
go run gen.go

# 2. Build CSS with TailwindCSS
tailwindcss -i input.css -o _static/dist/styles.css

# 3. Build Go application
go build
```

## Advanced Features

### Generator Configuration
```go
type Handler interface {
    It(string) string
    Cache() map[string]CacheValue
    SetCache(map[string]CacheValue)
}

// Custom generator
g := twerge.New(customHandler)

// Default generator  
g := twerge.Default()
```

### Cache Management
```go
// Access cache
cache := g.Cache()

// Cache value structure
type CacheValue struct {
    Generated string // Short class name (e.g., "tw-1")
    Merged    string // Final merged classes
}
```

## Project Structure

```
twerge/
├── twerge.go          # Core class processing engine
├── tw.go              # Code generation system  
├── config.go          # TailwindCSS configuration and conflict resolution
├── debug.go           # Debug utilities
├── examples/          # Example integrations
│   ├── simple/        # Basic usage
│   ├── dashboard/     # Complex dashboard
│   └── admin-dashboard/ # Advanced admin interface
├── internal/files/    # Internal file utilities
└── benchmarks/        # Performance benchmarks
```

## Key Files for Understanding
- `twerge.go:15-25` - Main It() function implementation
- `tw.go:45-60` - CodeGen() function for static generation  
- `config.go:100-200` - Class conflict resolution logic
- `examples/*/gen.go` - Code generation patterns
- `examples/*/views/*.templ` - Usage examples in templates

## Performance Benefits

1. **Runtime Speed**: Static class lookups instead of runtime parsing
2. **Bundle Size**: Short generated class names reduce CSS size
3. **Conflict Resolution**: Automatic handling of competing classes
4. **Build-Time Optimization**: All processing happens during build, not runtime
5. **TailwindCSS Integration**: Works seamlessly with TailwindCSS purging and optimization

## Best Practices

1. Use `twerge.It()` for all TailwindCSS classes in templates
2. Use `twerge.If()` for conditional class application  
3. Run CodeGen as part of your build process
4. Include generated CSS in your TailwindCSS build pipeline
5. Avoid manual string concatenation for class names
6. Test class merging behavior with conflicting classes
